problem: $55.7M total could be misread as an eBay-only payment.
evidence_or_reason: S014/S017 show multiple payors plus charitable commitments.
recommended_fix: Always characterize as total settlement package; specify eBay direct compensation share as $46.15M when needed.
resolution_note: Guardrail added to Claims Ledger and Fact Check.

problem: Summary-judgment survival can be mistaken for a finding of liability.
evidence_or_reason: S009 uses reasonable-jury standard; settlement prevented trial verdict.
recommended_fix: Use 'court held a jury could find' and state no criminal charges against the three executives.
resolution_note: Explicit wording lock added.

problem: Signed settlement agreement not captured.
evidence_or_reason: Detailed terms publicly announced by plaintiffs' counsel, agreement confirmed by eBay, corroborated Reuters/Bloomberg.
recommended_fix: Do not claim unpublished terms; retain source triangulation.
resolution_note: Not blocking Stage 02.

problem: Flash-forward opening could imply the $55.7M settlement occurred immediately after the 2019 conduct.
evidence_or_reason: Final settlement came in July 2026 after criminal and civil proceedings.
recommended_fix: Label flash-forward clearly and return to 2019 before causal explanation.
resolution_note: Timeline explicitly separates flash-forward payoff from chronological chain.

problem: Powerful internal messages could be framed as proof executives ordered criminal conduct.
evidence_or_reason: S009 preserves material limits and reasonable-jury standard.
recommended_fix: Pair messages with explicit no-direct-communication/civil-liability boundary.
resolution_note: Counterweight beat locked into Story Map.

problem: Shock-object catalog could turn episode into derivative true-crime recap.
evidence_or_reason: Channel positioning requires business mechanism and consequence.
recommended_fix: Limit shock props and shift quickly to security chain / organizational mechanism.
resolution_note: Story Map caps harassment montage and prioritizes mechanism.

problem: $3M DPA penalty and $55.7M settlement could be falsely totaled or treated as one award.
evidence_or_reason: They are separate legal resolutions with different payees/categories.
recommended_fix: Use separate criminal and civil consequence buckets; never create unsupported grand total.
resolution_note: Money buckets locked in Story Map.

problem: Cost $56 Million could be read as an eBay-only payment even though the package includes former executives and charitable commitments.
evidence_or_reason: Claims C028-C029 / announced settlement allocation.
recommended_fix: Keep title provisional and test safer wording during Stage 04/17.
resolution_note: Review required before title lock.

problem: Internal executive quotes are high-risk if stripped from procedural context.
evidence_or_reason: Claims C004-C008 / S009 court order.
recommended_fix: Verify exact quote/context in Stage 04 and preserve explicit liability limitations.
resolution_note: Stage 04 verified quote/context and final script preserves adjacent liability limitations.

problem: Harassment details can overpower channel differentiation.
evidence_or_reason: Story Map requires mechanism-first framing.
recommended_fix: Keep shock-item passage short and spend more runtime on organization/legal consequences.
resolution_note: V1 limits the object list and transitions to operational mechanism.

problem: The employees were fired overgeneralizes employment outcomes across all seven prosecuted participants.
evidence_or_reason: S009 specifically documents leave/termination for several participants and Zea contract termination.
recommended_fix: Replace with narrower statement about key members removed/terminated and separately state all prosecuted participants pleaded guilty.
resolution_note: V2 now says key members were removed/terminated and separately states all seven prosecuted participants pleaded guilty.

problem: Stops being explainable as only a handful of employees going rogue implies institutional culpability beyond the DPA's precise legal meaning.
evidence_or_reason: DPA establishes corporate charges/admissions/penalty but does not require this rhetorical inference.
recommended_fix: Replace with direct statement that legal consequences now attached to eBay itself.
resolution_note: V2 directly states that eBay itself entered a federal criminal resolution tied to the conduct.

problem: Wenig's defense position is underdeveloped relative to the damaging internal-message evidence.
evidence_or_reason: Reuters/Boston Globe reporting records his lawyers arguing no knowledge/involvement and a PR-response interpretation.
recommended_fix: Add attributed defense sentence adjacent to summary-judgment discussion.
resolution_note: V2 adds Wenig's attributed defense position immediately after the court-standard explanation.

problem: FidoMaster description is vague and could imply identity was established.
evidence_or_reason: Court order says it was a commenter username the security team believed was connected to the Steiners.
recommended_fix: State that exact relationship.
resolution_note: V2 identifies FidoMaster as a commenter username the security team believed was connected to the Steiners.

problem: Actual filings can expose home address/phone number and shock imagery could dominate packaging.
evidence_or_reason: YouTube harassment and advertiser-friendly rules restrict doxxing and assess graphic/shocking focus.
recommended_fix: Redact personal data; avoid graphic pig-mask/shock thumbnail; keep documentary context on-screen/audio.
resolution_note: Carry to visual planning and packaging.

problem: Photorealistic AI reenactments of real people/events would require YouTube disclosure and could mislead if presented as evidence.
evidence_or_reason: Current YouTube AI disclosure policy requires disclosure for realistic generated/altered events or real-person actions.
recommended_fix: Prefer clearly illustrative reconstruction; disclose realistic AI use; never present as authentic footage.
resolution_note: Carry to Stage 12/18.

problem: Post-hook background can briefly lower energy after a high-intensity cold open.
evidence_or_reason: V2 moves from eBay/security reveal into publication background.
recommended_fix: Tighten the first S02 background lines without removing the scale/criticism setup.
resolution_note: Final script compresses publication background and reaches scale/criticism contrast faster.

problem: Four major names/roles accumulate quickly.
evidence_or_reason: Viewer must track Wenig/Wymer/Baugh/Jones while also processing legal caveats.
recommended_fix: Use clearer first-introduction role labels and avoid repeating full titles in narration.
resolution_note: Final script attaches concise roles to first appearances; future visuals should mirror them.

problem: Summary-judgment mechanics plus three executive positions create the likely retention trough.
evidence_or_reason: All nuance is legally required but one explanatory layer is repetitive.
recommended_fix: Compress doctrine wording while preserving Wenig/Wymer/Jones fairness and no-final-liability language.
resolution_note: Final script reduces doctrine to one compact distinction and preserves all party/legal-status safeguards.

problem: An early CTA could weaken the brand-specific final payoff.
evidence_or_reason: Existing ending already lands the channel thesis.
recommended_fix: Do not place subscribe CTA before the final WHAT IT COST line.
resolution_note: Final script preserves the uninterrupted ending; lock note forbids CTA before the final payoff.

problem: Stage 07 micro-edits could break claim-section mapping.
evidence_or_reason: All material assertions remain within the same S01-S12 section references used by CLAIMS_LEDGER.
recommended_fix: Keep section IDs stable and treat 07_SCRIPT_FINAL.md as sole canonical narration.
resolution_note: Section mapping preserved; no material fact/legal-status change introduced.

problem: Delivery normalization could accidentally alter locked factual or legal meaning.
evidence_or_reason: Stage 08 is derived only from locked 07_SCRIPT_FINAL.md and transformations are limited to spoken dates/years and unambiguous abbreviations.
recommended_fix: Preserve S01-S12 wording and section mapping; prohibit factual/legal rewrites.
resolution_note: 08_VOICE_SCRIPT.md preserves the locked narrative and legal boundaries; only spoken normalization was applied.

problem: Unverified phonetic respellings could introduce pronunciation errors before engine selection.
evidence_or_reason: Multiple names and place names require listening/reference verification rather than guessed phonetics.
recommended_fix: Carry named pronunciation targets to Stage 09 and do not invent phonetic spellings in Stage 08.
resolution_note: Stage 09 locks high-confidence pronunciations and prohibits speculative person-name respellings; uncertain names require auditory confirmation during Stage 10 QC.

problem: Year 1999 remained numeric after Stage 08 normalization.
evidence_or_reason: All other years had been converted to spoken English.
recommended_fix: Normalize 1999 to nineteen ninety-nine.
resolution_note: 08_VOICE_SCRIPT.md corrected during Stage 09.

problem: Delivery transformations could drift from the locked final script.
evidence_or_reason: Reverse-normalization comparison of S01-S12 produced an exact semantic-text match.
recommended_fix: Lock Stage 08 as the canonical TTS derivative and prohibit narrative rewrites in Stage 10.

problem: Some personal surnames do not have sufficiently reliable text-only pronunciation evidence for a safe phonetic override.
evidence_or_reason: Speculative respelling can create a wrong canonical pronunciation.
recommended_fix: Keep canonical spelling and require Stage 10 auditory verification before final master acceptance.
resolution_note: Carry to Stage 10 audio QC; this does not authorize generation.

evidence_or_reason: Reference production workflow used text2speech_v2 + ElevenLabs with four long-form chunks; all four current eBay chunks passed read-only validation.
recommended_fix: Reject Seed Audio for this production run and restore four-part text2speech_v2 workflow.

evidence_or_reason: Repeated ASR inspection of original Part D resolved the amount as 158.7 / $1.58.7 rather than the intended 58.7.
